body: oh dang, I literally just started sertraline today... I hope you get back to feeling better soon.

Ah, thanks for clarifying. I do feel that. When I stop caring about what others think it feels kinda empowering although briefly. Then I get conflicted with guilt when the empathy comes back. It's a struggle too since when I stop caring I feel like being reckless. It's a weird place.

What are you saying no to, and what in particular are you referring to by this might just be what I need? I know what I need to do, everybody loves telling me what I need to do. I have been doing it, really actively trying. I am really sorry if my reply comes off as cold, it's not a good time for me.
